description:
You are a QA manager preparing for a v1.1 release. The project requires complete test coverage for all functional requirements in the SRS document's 'File Operations' section before the release can proceed.

After analyzing the traceability matrix, you have identified that the following SRS requirements in the 'File Operations' section have NO verification traceability links from the TESTS document and need test cases:

1. SRS-61 (Document Template - creating template from document)
2. SRS-72 (Import - importing from MS Word)
3. SRS-76 (Export - exporting to HTML)

For each of these untested requirements, you must:
a) Navigate to the TESTS document
b) Create a new test suite under the 'Test Cases > File Operations' section
c) Give the test suite an appropriate heading describing what is being tested
d) Set the test suite status to 'Draft'
e) Create a verification traceability link from the new test suite to the corresponding SRS requirement

The test suites should follow the naming convention of existing test suites in the document (e.g., 'Open Local File', 'Save Local File').

Login credentials: The application is already open with the project loaded.

required_test_suites.srs_text_contains: export the displayed document view to HTML
